en.headline: Hong Kong’s first astronaut leads live Tiangong Class for students
en.dek: Lai Ka-ying and her Shenzhou-23 crewmates delivered a 90-minute science lesson from the space station to pupils at her alma mater and campuses across Hong Kong and Macao.
body: Hong Kong’s first astronaut Lai Ka-ying joined her Shenzhou-23 crewmates on Wednesday morning to host a live Tiangong Class for students in Hong Kong and Macao from the Tiangong space station.

The 90-minute session was staged at Tsuen Wan Public Ho Chuen Yiu Memorial College, Lai’s alma mater, and streamed to schools across the two regions as well as on television. Mission commander Zhu Yangzhu and Zhang Zhiyuan took part alongside Lai, demonstrating experiments including a spinning gyroscope, space kitchen facilities and daily routines in orbit.

Chief Executive John Lee attended the event. Lai encouraged students to build a strong foundation in mathematics and science and to keep pushing without fearing hardship. The class was jointly organised by the Hong Kong and Macao governments and the China Manned Space Agency.

zh.headline: 港產航天員黎家盈主持天宮課堂
zh.dek: 黎家盈聯同神舟二十三號乘組周三上午從空間站為港澳學生進行90分鐘直播授課，主場設於其母校荃灣公立何傳耀紀念中學。
body: 香港首位航天員黎家盈周三上午聯同神舟二十三號乘組，在天宮空間站為港澳學生主持「天宮課堂」直播授課。
90分鐘課堂於黎家盈母校荃灣公立何傳耀紀念中學舉行，並向港澳兩地校園及電視直播。指令長朱楊柱及張志遠與黎家盈一同示範陀螺儀實驗、空間站廚房設施及在軌日常生活。
行政長官李家超出席活動。黎家盈勉勵學生打好數理基礎，勇於面對困難。課堂由港澳政府及中國載人航天工程辦公室聯合舉辦。
